messages.subject: geom_density aes y argument
parts:
This works fine:

ggplot(data.frame(a=rexp(10))) + geom_density(aes(x=a))

But ? geom_density says that a 'y' argument is required to aes (?
stat_density mentions a y aes, but not required) and I get an internal
error if I include one:

ggplot(data.frame(a=rexp(10))) + geom_density(aes(x=a,y=1:10))
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'y' not found

I suppose this is a documentation error?
Also, it would be nice if ggplot gave a better error message in this case.

Thanks,

-s

R 2.9.1 Windows
ggplot2 0.8.3

On Thu, Sep 3, 2009 at 1:04 PM, Stavros Macrakis<macr...@alum.mit.edu> wrote:
>
> This works fine:
>
>      ggplot(data.frame(a=rexp(10))) + geom_density(aes(x=a))
>
> But ? geom_density says that a 'y' argument is required to aes (?
> stat_density mentions a y aes, but not required) and I get an internal
> error if I include one:

This is a little tricky - stat_density requires an x and produces a y,
and geom_ribbon requires both x and y. geom_density = stat_density +
geom_ribbon, so the net effect is to require x but not y.

>
>      ggplot(data.frame(a=rexp(10))) + geom_density(aes(x=a,y=1:10))
>      Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'y' not found
>
> I suppose this is a documentation error?
> Also, it would be nice if ggplot gave a better error message in this case.

I agree. I'll add it to my to do list, but I'm not sure how to pick
up on this case.
